region_scene_page.compact: This road starts with New York minimalism and UK volatility, then branches into melodic, political, and artier versions of the same refusal.
region_scene_page.standard: This road starts with New York minimalism and UK volatility, then branches into melodic, political, and artier versions of the same refusal. Sex Pistols' Anarchy in the U.K., Ramones, The Damned's Neat Neat Neat, and The Adverts' One Chord Wonders give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: This road starts with New York minimalism and UK volatility, then branches into melodic, political, and artier versions of the same refusal. Short songs, clipped riffs, shouted or sneered vocals, and DIY immediacy matter more than virtuoso rock display. Sex Pistols' Anarchy in the U.K., Ramones, The Damned's Neat Neat Neat, and The Adverts' One Chord Wonders give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
